params.body:
Our rule book names the agent a person talks to the Principal AI. The end-to-end story test still used the old name, so against the compiled book every read was refused, and `bextrust/tools/simulate.sh` failed at that step from a fresh clone of the four repositories.

With this change the script holds from a fresh clone, ending in the record verified with the gate's public key alone.

Only a test file changes. The old name remains in the signed test vectors and other unit tests, which do not run against our rule book.
params.title: The end-to-end story names the agent as the rule book does
